name: book-knowledge
description: Traceable ideas, arguments, literary elements, practices, and reading context distilled from books
purpose: Preserve what a work argues, depicts, or teaches without reducing the wiki to chapter summaries
Support comparison and synthesis across works while retaining attribution and passage provenance

include: works, authors, and materially discussed entities
attributed arguments, premises, objections, and limitations
concepts, themes, characters, settings, and practices
exclude: plot or chapter restatement with no retrieval value
claims detached from their author, work, edition, or passage

omit: unsupported claims promoted from an author's argument to fact
bibliographic repetition already captured on the book page

authorities: independently cited works for cross-work synthesis

triggers: a new edition or translation materially changes the cited passage

priorities: work, author, and attributed argument match
